list.name: segment
list.label: Segment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT metric_json->>'segment' AS segment FROM metrics WHERE metric_json IS NOT NULL AND metric_json->>'segment' IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1;

list.name: project
list.label: Project
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT project FROM metrics WHERE project IS NOT NULL AND (CASE WHEN COALESCE('$segment','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE metric_json->>'segment' = '$segment' END) ORDER BY 1;

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(project,'Unknown') AS project, SUM(CASE WHEN status='failing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failing_count FROM metrics WHERE (CASE WHEN COALESCE('$segment','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE metric_json->>'segment' = '$segment' END) AND (CASE WHEN COALESCE('${project:csv}','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE project IN (${project:csv}) END) GROUP BY COALESCE(project,'Unknown') ORDER BY failing_count DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT COALESCE(project,'Unknown') AS project, SUM(CASE WHEN status='failing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failing_count FROM metrics WHERE (CASE WHEN COALESCE('$segment','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE metric_json->>'segment' = '$segment' END) AND (CASE WHEN COALESCE('${project:csv}','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE project IN (${project:csv}) END) GROUP BY COALESCE(project,'Unknown') ORDER BY failing_count DESC NULLS LAST;

options.content: This view approximates risk as the count of metrics with status='failing'. To enrich with exemption aging and policy pass rate, integrate exemptions into the database or use Grafana JSON/CSV plugins.
